abstract.p: NUST Nova participates in RIRAG Shared Task, addressing two critical challenges: Task 1 involves retrieving relevant subsections from regulatory documents based on user queries, while Task 2 focuses on generating concise, contextually accurate answers using the retrieved information. We propose a Hybrid Retrieval Framework that combines graph-based retrieval, vector-based methods, and keyword matching (BM25) to enhance relevance and precision in regulatory QA. Using score-based fusion and iterative refinement, the framework retrieves the top 10 relevant passages, which are then used by an LLM to generate accurate, context-aware answers. After empirical evaluation, we also conduct an error analysis to identify our framework's limitations.
